description:
Inter Women should have won in Vienna — Ivana Andrés saved them with the last kick.

CONFIRMED · Inter.it (Oct 1): Ivana Andrés equalized in the 93rd minute at the Franz-Horr-Stadion — Austria Wien 1–1 Inter, matchday 2 of the Women's Champions League. Inter are sixth on four points.
REPORTED · Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInter1908 (Oct 2): Hakan Calhanoglu took part in some of Thursday's session with the group at Appiano Gentile, his first group work since his injury; the paper expects him back for Parma.
NEUTRAL: Next in Serie A — Parma at San Siro, Saturday, October 10, 12:00 PM ET / 18:00 CEST, Paramount+ and Peacock Premium.
